text: Bitcoin is holding near $76k with modest losses, while Ethereum is pulling back harder at -2.3%, suggesting some rotation away from altcoins. The Fear & Greed Index sits at neutral 51 but has declined 15 points over a week, indicating weakening conviction despite stable pricing. Bitcoin dominance at 59% and $105B in daily volume reflect measured activity—neither panic nor enthusiasm, but a consolidation phase where risk appetite is contracting.
